exposure: Established Necrotizing Enterocolitis (NEC) protocol (including premature delivery by cesarean section)
cohort: The participants were 108 Sprague-Dawley rats randomized by litter into control and Necrotizing Enterocolitis (NEC) groups.
finding: PDGF and PDGF receptor expression are altered in experimental Necrotizing Enterocolitis (NEC), with dysregulation of PDGF potentially contributing to the development of NEC.
mod_finding: Controls, delivered vaginally and dam-fed, showed different ileal PDGF and receptor concentrations compared to NEC groups, which were delivered prematurely by cesarean section, indicating mode of birth as part of the experimental differentiation.
